title: MediaPlayer
description: A media player with audio/video playback, captions and keyboard controls. The React player package adds HLS/DASH/FLV engines, source quality selection, playlists, A–B repeat, waveforms, screenshots and recording.

advanced.advancedText: Use the dedicated entry for the full React player. The original minerva-design MediaPlayer export remains available with its existing props and event payloads; both use the same playback implementation.
advanced.boundary: Streaming engines are browser adapters: codecs, CORS, autoplay and secure-context capabilities still apply. The advanced demos below are React DOM examples. Other framework and native tabs document their own supported APIs; React Native and mini-programs require their media hosts.
advanced.assets: The examples play our Minerva Design film and its soundtrack from local files, with 720p and 360p video renditions. HLS, DASH and FLV use the same film. Screenshot and recording controls appear where supported; recording downloads a file on completion.

sources.title: Sources and engines
sources.text: src accepts a URL or PlayerSource with type, mimeType, qualities and defaultQuality. HLS/DASH expose adaptive levels; createHlsEngine/createDashEngine/createFlvEngine and engines let you configure or replace adapters. Stream libraries load only when needed.

playback.title: Playback and audio
playback.text: playlist holds source/title/poster entries; defaultPlaylistIndex and onPlaylistIndexChange observe the current item. Audio and video share one engine. waveform accepts auto, decorative or peak values; A–B repeat and Media Session are optional.

controls.title: Controls and custom actions
controls.text: controls can be false for bare media or an object that enables play, progress, volume, quality, speed, captions, skip, abRepeat, playlist, screenshot, record, pip and fullscreen. actions and renderTooltip integrate host actions and tooltips without application dependencies.

events.title: Events and errors
events.text: The advanced entry calls onTimeUpdate(currentTime, duration), onMetadata({ width, height, duration }), onQualityChange(id) and onError(PlayerError). The root minerva-design export retains its object-shaped time callback and native MediaError callback.

handle.title: Imperative handle
handle.text: The ref exposes play/pause/seek and element/video, plus setPlaybackRate, setQuality, next/previous, setAbRepeat/clearAbRepeat, screenshot, startRecording/stopRecording and toggleFullscreen. play returns its promise so the host can handle browser playback rejection.

appearance.title: Appearance and capability boundaries
appearance.text: locale supports en/zh/ja/fr and messages overrides control text; theme selects light/dark. Import the player CSS once. PiP, recording, screenshot, volume and fullscreen depend on the host; cross-origin capture requires suitable CORS headers. DRM licensing is not configured by the built-in adapters. In flex or grid layouts, give the surrounding container a width; maxWidth only limits its size.

vars.name: --media-player-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the player (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --media-player-accent
vars.description: Color of the played range and the slider thumbs (defaults to --primary-color)

vars.name: --media-player-video-background
vars.description: Letterbox color behind a video (defaults to black)

vars.name: --media-player-overlay-background
vars.description: Background of the video control bar (defaults to a dark scrim that keeps controls legible over bright frames)

vars.name: --media-player-overlay-color
vars.description: Text and icon color over a video (defaults to white)

vars.name: --media-player-bar-background
vars.description: Background of the audio bar (defaults to --surface-color)

vars.name: --media-player-bar-color
vars.description: Text and icon color of the audio bar (defaults to --text-color)

vars.name: --media-player-button-size
vars.description: Size of the control buttons (defaults to the density's small control height)

vars.name: --media-player-track-height
vars.description: Thickness of the seek and volume tracks (defaults to 4px)

vars.name: --media-player-captions-background
vars.description: Background of the caption text (defaults to rgb(0 0 0 / 75%) over a video, none for audio)

vars.name: --media-player-captions-color
vars.description: Color of the caption text (defaults to white over a video, the bar color for audio)

vars.name: --media-player-captions-font-size
vars.description: Font size of the caption text (defaults to --font-size-lg over a video, --font-size-md for audio)

examples.title: Video
examples.description: A <video> with a dark translucent control bar that fades out while playing (it stays visible on touch screens, on hover and on focus). Focus the player: Space / K play-pause, ← / → seek by 5 s, ↑ / ↓ volume, M mute, F fullscreen. pictureInPicture adds a button where the browser supports it. Narrow players keep the primary actions on one row; skip buttons and the volume slider yield space while keyboard shortcuts remain available.

examples.title: Audio
examples.description: Media type is inferred from MIME type or the URL; audio uses a compact cover/waveform interface with shared playback controls. skipSeconds={0} hides the skip buttons.

examples.title: Resume and progress
examples.description: startTime resumes once the metadata loads; (timeUpdate) reports the progress; play(), pause() and seek() are public methods.

examples.title: Captions
examples.description: tracks accepts WebVTT or SRT files ({ src, srclang, label, kind, default }; data: URLs here). The player draws safe caption text over video and below audio. Select a track in Settings → Captions, or press C to toggle it. Language choice is remembered; onTrackChange reports selection. Cross-origin files require CORS; use-credentials includes credentials.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Media type is inferred from MIME type or the URL; audio uses a compact cover/waveform interface with shared playback controls. skipSeconds={0} hides the skip buttons.

resume.title: Resume and progress
resume.description: startTime is applied once when the metadata loads (resume where the learner stopped). onTimeUpdate / onLoadedMetadata / onPause / onEnded report the progress; the ref exposes play(), pause(), seek(seconds) and the media element.

rates-skip.title: Speeds and skip step
rates-skip.description: playbackRates configures Settings → Playback speed; onRateChange reports changes. skipSeconds sets the skip buttons; aspectRatio or height sizes the video.

captions.title: Captions
captions.description: tracks accepts WebVTT or SRT files ({ src, srclang, label, kind, default }; data: URLs here). The player draws safe caption text over video and below audio. Select a track in Settings → Captions, or press C to toggle it. Language choice is remembered; onTrackChange reports selection. Cross-origin files require CORS; use-credentials includes credentials.

streams.title: Streaming engines
streams.description: Switch between real, locally hosted HLS, DASH and FLV samples. The selected adapter loads on demand; progressive files and native HLS remain available where supported.

quality.title: Quality selection
quality.description: Choose 144p or 72p in Settings → Quality. These are different video renditions; switching keeps the playback position and playing state. HLS/DASH sources can additionally expose adaptive quality levels.

playlist.title: Playlist and A–B repeat
playlist.description: The playlist shares one player across video and audio. Previous/next and automatic advance are built in. Audio displays a waveform; use A–B to repeat a passage. The main entry time callback receives (currentTime, duration).

capture.title: Screenshot and recording
capture.description: Use the built-in screenshot and recording icons, or S/R shortcuts. Recording is limited to 15 seconds here. Browsers must support canvas capture/MediaRecorder and cross-origin media must allow canvas access.

desktop.title: Desktop player · same presentation as the PC client
desktop.description: The PC client uses this full player, adding only its tooltip and save-file adapters.

audio-waveform.title: Audio waveform and A–B repeat
audio-waveform.description: Decode the local audio into a real waveform; seek, change speed and repeat a selected interval.

compact.title: Compact muted preview
compact.description: A compact looping preview starts muted; the full player remains available in the complete presentation.

recovery.title: Failure and source recovery
recovery.description: Try a missing resource, retry, then switch to the valid source.

MediaPlayerProps.type: Kind of media; inferred from mimeType, else from the file extension of src, else "video"
MediaPlayerProps.mimeType: MIME type of the media ("audio/mpeg", "video/mp4"...), used to infer type
MediaPlayerProps.poster: Image shown before a video plays
MediaPlayerProps.title: Title of the media, shown in the audio bar / over the video
MediaPlayerProps.autoPlay: Starts playing as soon as possible (browsers only allow muted autoplay without a user gesture)
MediaPlayerProps.muted: Mutes the media; applied whenever it changes (the mute button still toggles the sound)
MediaPlayerProps.preload: How much of the media the browser loads before playback
MediaPlayerProps.crossOrigin: CORS mode of the media request (cross-origin caption files need it too, plus CORS headers on their server)
MediaPlayerProps.startTime: Resume position in seconds, applied once when the metadata loads (and again when src changes)
MediaPlayerProps.playbackRates: Speeds the speed button cycles through
MediaPlayerProps.skipSeconds: Step of the skip back / forward buttons, in seconds (0 hides them)
MediaPlayerProps.controls: Shows the custom control bar; false renders the bare media element (drive it through the ref)
MediaPlayerProps.height: Height of a video player (number: pixels); overrides aspectRatio
MediaPlayerProps.aspectRatio: Aspect ratio of a video player (CSS aspect-ratio)
MediaPlayerProps.pictureInPicture: Shows a picture-in-picture button (video, where the browser supports it)
MediaPlayerProps.tracks: Captions / subtitles: WebVTT or SRT files ({ src, srclang, label, kind, default }) rendered as <track> children and drawn by the player, with a captions menu in the control bar; the choice is remembered (localStorage)
MediaPlayerProps.onTimeUpdate: Called while playing with the playhead position and the duration ({ currentTime, duration }, seconds)
MediaPlayerProps.onEnded: Called when playback reaches the end
MediaPlayerProps.onLoadedMetadata: Called with the duration once the metadata is loaded ({ duration })
MediaPlayerProps.onError: Called with the MediaError when the media can't be loaded or played
MediaPlayerProps.onRateChange: Called with the new playback speed
MediaPlayerProps.onVolumeChange: Called when the volume or the muted state changes ({ volume, muted })
MediaPlayerProps.onTrackChange: Called when the user chooses captions ({ index, track }; index -1 and track null: Off)
MediaPlayerProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the player (defaults to title, else "Media player")
MediaPlayerProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
MediaPlayerProps.ref: Imperative handle: play(), pause(), seek(seconds), element

MediaPlayerHandle.play: Starts playback and returns the native play promise; callers can handle autoplay rejections.
MediaPlayerHandle.seek: Moves the playhead to seconds (clamped to the duration)

MediaPlayerTrack.src: URL of the WebVTT (.vtt) or SubRip (.srt) file; data: URLs work
MediaPlayerTrack.srclang: Language of the track (BCP 47: "en", "fr-CA"), also what the remembered choice matches
MediaPlayerTrack.label: Name shown in the captions menu
MediaPlayerTrack.default: Shown when the user has not chosen captions yet

cssVars.--media-player-overlay-background: Background of the video control bar (defaults to a dark scrim that keeps controls legible over bright frames)
cssVars.--media-player-overlay-color: Text and icon color over a video (defaults to white)
cssVars.--media-player-bar-background: Background of the audio bar (defaults to --surface-color)
cssVars.--media-player-bar-color: Text and icon color of the audio bar (defaults to --text-color)

cssVars.--media-player-captions-color: Color of the caption text (defaults to white over a video, the bar color for audio)

video.title: Video
video.description: The heading slot is the title over the video; picture-in-picture adds a button where the browser supports it. Focus the player: Space / K, arrows, M and F.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: An .mp3 src (or mime-type="audio/…") renders the audio bar; skip-seconds="0" hides the skip buttons.

resume.title: Resume and progress
resume.description: start-time resumes once the metadata loads. The media events don't cross the shadow root: listen to minerva-loaded-metadata, minerva-time-update, minerva-pause and minerva-ended; play() and seek() drive the player.

rates-skip.title: Speeds and skip step
rates-skip.description: playbackRates is a property (an array); minerva-rate-change reports the speed. skip-seconds sets the skip step and aspect-ratio sizes the video.

captions.title: Captions
captions.description: tracks is a property (an array of { src, srclang, label, kind, default }); without it, <track src srclang label default> children of the element are used. The player draws the cues and adds a captions menu; minerva-track-change reports the user's choice. Cross-origin files need crossorigin and CORS headers.

props.noControls: Hides the custom control bar: renders the bare media element (drive it from script)
props.element: The rendered <audio> / <video> element (read-only; null before the first render)
props.tracks: Captions / subtitles (property only): WebVTT or SRT files ({ src, srclang, label, kind, default }); empty: the <track> children are used

events.minerva-time-update: The playhead moved (detail: { currentTime, duration }, seconds).
events.minerva-error: The media can't be loaded or played (detail: { error }, the MediaError).
events.minerva-volume-change: The volume or the muted state changed (detail: { volume, muted }).
events.minerva-track-change: The user chose captions (detail: { index, track }; index -1 and track null: Off).

methods.play: Starts playback (autoplay rejections are swallowed: the player stays paused).
methods.seek: Moves the playhead to seconds (clamped to the duration).

slots.heading: Title of the media, shown in the audio bar / over the video.

basic.title: MediaControls (React Native)
basic.description: Core React Native has no media element: MediaControls is the themed control bar, driven by props (playing, currentTime, duration, buffered, muted, playbackRate) and callbacks (onPlayPause, onSeek, onMutedChange, onRateChange...). Wire it to expo-video / expo-audio (see the comment in the code); this preview simulates the player.

captions.title: Captions (React Native)
captions.description: React Native players have no text tracks: with tracks, MediaControls fetches the WebVTT / SRT file (data: URLs work), parses it and draws the cue at currentTime above the seek bar. The CC button shows an Off / per-track choice; trackIndex can be controlled and onTrackChange reports the choice.
